packageRules.description: Roslyn compiler and workspace versions are intentionally pinned for compatibility and language-version testing.
Roslyn compiler and workspace versions set via literal VersionOverride values in the language-version test projects are intentionally pinned.
Microsoft.Build.Framework and its Microsoft.NET.StringTools dependency drop .NET 10 support in 18.10 and later; restrict updates until we target .NET 11.
Cap the runner at the latest version verified with explicit dependencies and runtime files in derived test projects.
